In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] overseen by [[Nom Anor]] '''attempted to assassinate''' [[Cal Omas]] before he could become the new [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. However, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] foiled the attempt, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the assassins in the [[Water/Legends|seas]] of Mon Calamari.
